87: 1. One who informs on his fellow man (to gentiles) ends up being a vagabond, enemies rise up against him, he experiences himself that which he wanted to bring upon his fellow, all those who depend on him fall, and the family of the one he pursued takes his greatness.
2. One who informs (to gentiles) on the Tzaddik loses all his possessions.
3. It is permitted to kill an informer (to gentiles).
4. It is forbidden to deliver (to gentiles) even an evildoer to execution.
